# Security & Privacy Policy

## Local-First Privacy Guarantee
WishPilot is engineered with an uncompromising **Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK)** and **Local-First** privacy model:
- **Zero Remote Telemetry**: WishPilot never collects, stores, transmits, or aggregates user voice audio, transcripts, screenshots, or personal data to any external WishPilot server.
- **Direct Encrypted API Transport**: When an AI request or voice chunk is generated, it communicates directly with the user's chosen provider endpoint (e.g. Groq, Cerebras, OpenAI, Google) via direct HTTPS.
- **Local Storage Only**: All API credentials, candidate profiles, and session transcripts reside strictly in the candidate's local encrypted device storage.

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you discover a security vulnerability or have privacy concerns:
1. Please do not disclose vulnerabilities publicly in open GitHub issues.
2. Reach out directly to the author: **Vishwjeet Singh Vilkhu** via [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishwjeet27) or via GitHub security advisories.
3. Vulnerabilities will be addressed and patched promptly.
